tasks.label: compress-road-2-mp4-vp9-opus
args: cd media/video-2 && ffmpeg -y -i road-2.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -c:a libopus road-2.tmp.mp4 && mv -f road-2.tmp.mp4 road-2.mp4

tasks.label: probe-road-2-mp4
args: cd media/video-2 && ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=index,codec_name,codec_type -show_format=filename,format_name,duration,size,bit_rate road-2.mp4
